agent.result_text:
The full test suite passes (26 tests, 0 failures). 

## Summary

I changed the `customerCode` format from `<LAST3>-<NNNN>` to `<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>` with a per-city sequence.

**The one code change** — `AssignCustomerCode.java` (the function step wired into `owners.POST.yml`):
- **CITY3**: upper-cased first three letters of `owner.getCity()`
- **LAST3**: upper-cased first three letters of the last name (unchanged logic)
- **NNNN**: a per-city 4-digit sequence — one more than the number of existing owners already in that city (`findAll()` filtered by city, case-insensitively), computed before save so it excludes the owner being created
- Updated the class Javadoc to describe the new format (e.g. `SYD-SMI-0007`)

**Values derived from `customerCode` rebuild automatically**: the `membershipNumber` mapping in `OwnerMapper` is `String.format("%s-M%02d", owner.getCustomerCode(), …)`, so it composes over the new city-prefixed code with no change needed — confirmed by `Cp14Tests`, which recomputes it from the returned fields.

All new and existing tests are green, including `Cp09` (per-city consecutive sequence: `SYD-ALP-`, `SYD-BRA-`), `Cp16` (`[A-Z]{3}-[A-Z]{3}-\d{4}` format), and `Cp14`/`Cp15` (membership number & tier).
